TUESDAY THROWBACK: Manila Post Office Building, ca. 1950s

Completed in 1928, this 97-year-old building survived the destructive World War II. It was rebuilt in 1946. 

In 2023, a massive fire gutted the building.

Restoration is scheduled to begin in January 2026.
